entries.source: Set the top-left corner of this image on the output canvas. X and Y are whole pixels, starting at zero. Other images keep their current positions. Overlap is allowed here; images imported later are drawn on top. The canvas expands to include all placed images. Crops and sizes stay unchanged.
entries.target: 撻 𧣳 𨑗 邊 債 𧵑 影 尼 𨑗 椌 𡳒 頭 𠚢. X 吧 Y 𪜀 數 元 併 蹺 單位 點影, 扒 頭 自 0. 各 影 恪 𡨺 原 位置 現在. 於 低 朱 法 各 影 重 𬨠 僥; 影 得 入 𡢐 仕 得 𡳒 碮 𬨠 𨑗. 椌 𡳒 仕 𢲫 𢌌 抵 貯 悉 𪥘 各 影 㐌 撻. 份 割 吧 戟 𡱩 𡨺 原.
entries.note: Read as a connected Vietnamese instruction, all source clauses remain present and correctly scoped. The imperative targets this image’s upper-left corner on the output canvas. The next sentence predicates integer values of both X and Y and measures them in pixel units beginning at 0. Other images retain present positions. Permission applies to overlap; the later modifier attaches to import, and the following passive drawing clause puts those later imports above. Canvas growth has the purpose of containing every already placed image. The final coordinated subjects are crop regions and dimensions, both unchanged. Technical canvas/pixel compounds are understandable authored UI vocabulary. This acceptance is not based only on the supplied romanization or isolated character substitution.

entries.source: X and Y must be whole numbers from zero to 2147483647.
entries.target: X 吧 Y 沛 𪜀 數 元 自 0 𦤾 2147483647.
entries.note: The coordinated subject X and Y shares the mandatory integer predicate. The from-to complement restricts each coordinate to the exact inclusive endpoints 0 and 2147483647. The integer compound uses the mathematical character choice, while unchanged in the help uses a different contextual character. There is no positive-only restriction or permission for fractions.

entries.source: The selected image is no longer in this assembly.
entries.target: 影 㐌 譔 空 𡀳 𥪝 版 𢯖 尼.
entries.note: The full noun phrase identifies the previously selected image. Negation combines with the still-present element to express no longer; the following locative limits absence to this assembled composition. The postnominal demonstrative identifies this assembly. It does not claim deletion of the source file.
entries.full_replacement_candidate: 影 㐌 譔 空 𡀳 𥪝 版 𢯖 尼.

help_semantic_clause_audit.note: Imperative + corner noun phrase + possessive this-image phrase + on-output-canvas complement; physical upper-left remains explicit.
Both symbols share the copular integer predicate; pixel units are a measurement adjunct and 0 is the starting point.
Other images are the subject of retaining their present positions, not the moved image.
Permission construction governs reciprocal image overlap; not merely a statement that overlap may happen.
Later is inside the imported-image modifier. The later-imported images are then drawn over the others; edit order is not substituted.
Canvas is the expanding subject; the purpose clause contains the universal quantifier and every already placed image.
Both crop portion and dimensions are coordinated under the unchanged predicate.

orthographic_notes: Contextual review distinguishes mathematical nguyên from unchanged nguyên; copular là from unrelated homophones; stacking chồng from husband; movement lên from spatial trên; and phần cắt from unrelated homophonic entries.
The chosen forms for drawing, later and wider are attested alternatives; their simplified appearance is not by itself a language defect.

The base U+2A958 in the universal phrase is linguistically retained. The publisher displays it with E0101; exact preferred glyph shape remains a rendering/orthographic presentation check. The bundle has no format-14 UVS table. Do not blindly insert an unverified selector or replace the word for font convenience.
The sentences are modern Vietnamese composition in Han/Nom orthography. No source is claimed to contain these full UI strings, and no native-reader certification is claimed.
